parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Export file format: xlsx (default) or csv.

parameters.name: content_mode
parameters.description: summary = one row per sales order (default); line_items = one row per line item.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Which orders to export: filtered (default — current filters/sort), all (ignores filters), current_page, or selected.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated sales order IDs. Only used when scope=selected.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Comma-separated SO column keys to include (preserves order). Omit to export all columns. Available keys include: id, sales_order_number, customer_po_number, order_date, order_status, fulfillment_status, payment_status, customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_company, customer_phone, sales_channel_id, sales_channel_name, sub_sales_channel_name, integration, store_id, store, currency_code, currency_rate, subtotal, total, tax_total, discount_total, requested_shipping_method, shipping_method, tracking_number, sales_rep_name, tags, warehouse_names, line_item_count, ship_by_date, deliver_by_date, hold_until_date, approved_at, reserved_at, fulfilled_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at, shipping_address/city/province/zip/country, billing_address/city/province/zip/country.
